svg.title: Cost schedule versus discounted hedging-error RMSE
svg.desc: Synthetic P5.19a study, matched 20% path and model volatility, 1,536 paired paths. USD per configured short call with multiplier one. Across zero, baseline, and adverse stock costs, every-grid RMSE is 0.4232, 0.4311, and 0.5451; the 0.05 inventory threshold is 0.4611, 0.4661, and 0.5438. Lower means less error, not higher profit. The vertical axis starts at 0.40 USD. No established winner at adverse costs.
svg.metadata: Source: https://github.com/karisheen/Black-Scholes-Pricing-Model/blob/87d2b71bbedcef439dc653e62f561e2dc4f3acd7/docs/hedging-results.csv; path_volatility=0.2; policies=periodic_1,threshold_005; metric=discounted_error_rmse. Every-grid exact values: 0.42322497589409946,0.4311220457577079,0.5451426648907093. Threshold exact values: 0.46114963703133394,0.4661229915098142,0.543823021940553. Coordinates: x=70,190,310 for categorical cost schedules; y=640-900*RMSE.

g.text: Per short call · vertical axis starts at $0.40
